spanish: Solo a la parójet no entrará, y al altar no se acercará, porque defecto en él, y no profanará mis santuarios, porque yo Jehová su santificante.

findings.issue: Common noun (definite feminine singular) is left as the untranslated Hebraism parójet; common nouns stay Spanish.
Particle is tagged affirmation; Solo selects the restrictive sense (only).
Piel participle suffix is 3mp object; su does not mark plural and can be read as singular possessive of él.

notes: Verbless clauses kept without an unmarked copula; Jehová, 3ms verbs, and plural mis santuarios match the tokens.
